title: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on scaling competition-level mathematical proof generation in large language models, spanning the fields of mathematical reasoning, reinforcement learning, and test-time compute scaling for LLMs.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** It builds on prior work in neural-symbolic systems (AlphaGeometry, AlphaProof), RL-trained reasoning models (GRPO, DeepSeek-R1, Kimi K1.5), learned verifiers (Cobbe et al., 2021; Lightman et al., 2023), self-refinement, and inference-time scaling; its new contribution is MaxProof, a model-agnostic population-level test-time scaling framework paired with a defense-in-depth generative verifier that explicitly minimizes false positives to address reward hacking.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses how to push an LLM (MiniMax-M3) past the human gold-medal threshold on competition-level mathematical proof benchmarks (IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026) reliably converting best@K capability into stable pass@1 performance.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The paper trains three merged capabilities—Proof Expert (via CISPO with std-threshold filter under a 4-layer defense-in-depth verifier), Verifier Expert (joint error-finding and verdict classification), and Fixer Expert (rejection-sampling fine-tune on critique-conditioned repairs)—and at test time applies MaxProof, an evolutionary search loop over a population of 32 candidates with PATCH/REWRITE refinement, pessimistic-min verifier fitness, diverse parent selection, population-level early stop, and a pairwise tournament self-pick for final selection.

5. **📊 Results:** Standalone, M3 scores 67.40 on IMOProofBench and 81.56 on IMOAnswerBench, narrowing the gap to frontier closed-source systems; with MaxProof test-time scaling, M3 reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026 (gains of +8 and +10 over one-shot), exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both contests, though one problem (USAMO 2026 P2) exhibits a 4-point selection loss.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 论文聚焦于大语言模型中竞赛级数学证明的规模化生成，涵盖数学推理、强化学习以及LLM测试时计算扩展等领域。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 该研究建立在神经-符号系统（AlphaGeometry、AlphaProof）、RL训练的推理模型（GRPO、DeepSeek-R1、Kimi K1.5）、学习验证器（Cobbe等2021；Lightman等2023）、自精炼以及推理时计算扩展等先前工作之上；其新贡献是MaxProof——一个模型无关的种群级测试时扩展框架，配合显式最小化假阳性以应对奖励黑客的纵深防御生成式验证器。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了如何将LLM（MiniMax-M3）推过IMO 2025和USAMO 2026竞赛级数学证明基准的人类金牌分数线，可靠地将best@K能力转化为稳定的pass@1性能。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文训练了三个融合的能力——Proof Expert（通过CISPO结合std阈值滤波器，在四层纵深防御验证器下进行训练）、Verifier Expert（联合错误查找和判定分类）、Fixer Expert（对批评条件修复进行拒绝采样微调），并在测试时应用MaxProof，一种对32个候选种群进行进化搜索的循环，包含PATCH/REWRITE精炼、悲观最小验证器适应度、多样化父代选择、种群级早停以及用于最终选择的成对锦标赛自选。

5. **📊 结果：** 在独立测试中，M3在IMOProofBench上获得67.40分、在IMOAnswerBench上获得81.56分，缩小了与前沿闭源系统的差距；通过MaxProof测试时扩展，M3在IMO 2025上达到35/42、在USAMO 2026上达到36/42（相比单次生成分别提升+8和+10），在两项比赛中均超过人类金牌分数线，但USAMO 2026 P2存在4分的选择损失。

question3.option1: To reduce per-round computational cost by parallelizing refinement calls

question3.option3: To ensure that all offspring candidates have the same output length as their parents

question1.option2: 格式黑客（Format hacking）
question1.option3: 评判员特定偏好（Judge-specific preference）

question2.question: 在Proof Expert的CISPO训练中，std-threshold过滤器的作用是什么？

question2.option3: 为下一轮迭代选择验证器分数最高的候选

question3.question: 在MaxProof循环中，框架为什么为每个被选中的父代同时维护PATCH和REWRITE两种优化模式？
question3.option1: 通过并行化优化调用来降低每轮计算成本
question3.option2: 在搜索中平衡利用（PATCH在保留结构的同时修正错误）和探索（REWRITE尝试不同的证明路径）

title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** This paper focuses on language-conditioned robot manipulation policy learning, situated at the intersection of robotics, geometric computer vision, and foundation models for embodied AI.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** It builds on Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), World Action Models (WAMs), and Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs), and proposes the new idea of repurposing a pretrained GFM as a unified shared backbone that jointly performs perception, temporal world modeling, and action decoding in a single token space.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the lack of explicit 3D geometric reasoning in existing 2D-based robot policies, which limits generalization and robustness to environmental perturbations such as camera viewpoint changes.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** GAM splits a pretrained GFM at an intermediate layer, uses shallow layers as an observation encoder, inserts a causal transformer as a future predictor conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history, and routes predicted future tokens through the deep GFM blocks for joint future-geometry and action decoding, trained with action, feature, and depth losses.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** GAM achieves 97.6% success on LIBERO and 85.5% on LIBERO-Plus (a 9.7% gain in camera-perturbation robustness over prior best), runs 55× faster than Cosmos-Policy at 6.9 ms/145 Hz with only 1.4B parameters, and also outperforms baselines on real-world manipulation tasks and RoboCasa-Kitchen.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 本文聚焦于语言条件下的机器人操作策略学习，处于机器人学、几何计算机视觉与具身智能基础模型的交叉领域。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 本文基于视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）、世界动作模型（WAM）以及几何基础模型（GFM），提出新思路：将被预训练的几何基础模型重新用作统一共享主干，在单一 token 空间中同时实现感知、时序世界建模与动作解码。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了现有基于 2D 的机器人策略缺乏显式 3D 几何推理能力的问题，该局限导致策略在相机视角变化等环境扰动下的泛化性与鲁棒性不足。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** GAM 在预训练 GFM 的中间层将其拆分，将浅层作为观测编码器，插入以语言、本体感知与历史动作条件化的因果 Transformer 作为未来预测器，并将预测的未来 token 送入深层 GFM 模块进行几何与动作联合解码，通过动作、特征与深度三项损失进行端到端训练。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** GAM 在 LIBERO 上达到 97.6% 成功率，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 85.5%（相机扰动设置较此前最优提升 9.7%），仅需 1.4B 参数即以 6.9 ms（145 Hz）运行、相比 Cosmos-Policy 提速约 55 倍，并在真实机器人任务与 RoboCasa-Kitchen 上均优于基线。

question1.question: How does GAM fundamentally differ from prior geometry-aware VLAs (e.g., ROCKET, Spatial Forcing) in its use of the Geometric Foundation Model (GFM)?
question1.option1: GAM uses the GFM as a frozen feature extractor feeding into a separate VLA, while the others train the GFM end-to-end with action supervision.
question1.option2: GAM actively repurposes the GFM's deep blocks to decode predicted future tokens, making the GFM an active part of the policy's predictive pathway rather than just a static feature source.
question1.option3: GAM discards the GFM entirely and trains a 3D encoder from scratch on robot trajectories.

question2.question: In GAM's multi-task training objective L_total = λ_act·L_act + λ_feat·L_feat + λ_depth·L_depth, what specific role does the future-feature loss L_feat play?
question2.option1: It supervises the action head's output to match ground-truth expert action chunks via L1 regression.
question2.option2: It anchors the causal future predictor's predicted future tokens Ẑ^(Ls)_{t'+1} to the actual next-frame features Z^(Ls)_{t'+1} extracted from a frozen GFM.
question2.option3: It penalizes the predicted depth map to enforce scale-invariance and gradient-matching against ground truth.

question3.question: What is the primary architectural reason GAM achieves a ~55x inference speedup over diffusion-based policies like Cosmos-Policy while using only 1.4B parameters?
question3.option1: GAM uses much lower-resolution input images (e.g., 64x64) compared to the 224x224 used by baselines.
question3.option2: GAM performs single-pass feed-forward prediction via causal token decoding, avoiding the multi-step iterative denoising required by diffusion policies.
question3.option3: GAM runs on specialized hardware accelerators that are not available to the baseline methods.

question1.question: GAM与之前的几何感知VLA（如ROCKET、Spatial Forcing）相比，在使用几何基础模型（GFM）方面有什么根本不同？
question1.option1: GAM将GFM用作冻结的特征提取器来馈送单独的VLA，而其他方法则用动作监督对GFM进行端到端训练。
question1.option2: GAM主动重新利用GFM的深度模块来解码预测的未来token，使GFM成为策略预测路径的活跃部分，而不仅仅是一个静态特征源。
question1.option3: GAM完全丢弃GFM，并从头在机器人轨迹上训练3D编码器。

question2.question: 在GAM的多任务训练目标 L_total = λ_act·L_act + λ_feat·L_feat + λ_depth·L_depth 中，未来特征损失 L_feat 具体扮演什么角色？
question2.option1: 它通过L1回归监督动作头的输出以匹配真实的专家动作块。
question2.option2: 它将因果未来预测器预测的未来token Ẑ^(Ls)_{t'+1} 锚定到从冻结的GFM提取的实际下一帧特征 Z^(Ls)_{t'+1}。
question2.option3: 它对预测的深度图施加惩罚，以实现尺度不变性和梯度匹配。

question3.question: GAM仅使用1.4B参数，却相比基于扩散的策略（如Cosmos-Policy）实现了约55倍推理速度提升，其主要架构原因是什么？
question3.option1: GAM使用比基线方法（224x224）低得多的输入图像分辨率（例如64x64）。
question3.option2: GAM通过因果token解码执行单次前向传播预测，避免了扩散策略所需的多步迭代去噪。
question3.option3: GAM运行在基线方法无法使用的专用硬件加速器上。

title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper presents an interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation, spanning photorealistic, game-style, and stylized visual domains, within computer vision and generative AI.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** It builds on Wan2.2-TI2V, PRoPE, causal forcing, DMD distillation, and self-forcing autoregressive video generation, introducing novel components like E-PRoPE (lightweight projective positional encoding on downsampled tokens), Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence with geometry-based retrieval, residual recycling, Event Instruction Tuning for composable multi-entity events, and RL-based post-distillation alignment.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses three coupled challenges: translating prescribed camera trajectories into consistent viewpoint changes across heterogeneous domains, preserving scene content and identity during long-horizon revisits (mitigating style/color drift in autoregressive generation), and achieving real-time streaming latency without sacrificing quality or controllability.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The method combines a multi-source data engine (UE5 with ground-truth camera poses, real-world videos with recovered geometry, and game data), a progressive training pipeline (camera-aware E-PRoPE, memory conditioning with error injection, event instruction tuning, DMD-forcing distillation, and conservative DiffusionNFT RL alignment), and inference optimizations (INT8/FP8 quantization, sequence parallelism, pruned VAE decoding, TeaCache-style residual reuse, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism).

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** On 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World-1.0-5B achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and overall score of 84.76, surpassing HY-WorldPlay 1.5 (80.79) and LingBot-World (80.45); on 30-second long-horizon rollouts, it leads with 70.41 overall; in memory revisit consistency it tops pixel, perceptual, semantic, and place-recognition metrics; in human preference it wins 57.5%–61.9% overall; and the system runs up to 16 FPS on 8 RTX 5090 GPUs.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 论文提出了一个面向可控长时序生成的通用交互式文本/图像到视频世界模型，涵盖写实、游戏和风格化视觉领域，属于计算机视觉与生成式AI方向。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 基于Wan2.2-TI2V、PRoPE、因果强制、DMD蒸馏和自回归视频生成等研究，提出E-PRoPE（在降采样token上做轻量投影位置编码）、基于几何检索的记忆条件场景持久化、残差回收、可组合多实体事件指令调优以及蒸馏后RL对齐等新思路。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决三个核心难题：在异构领域中将相机轨迹转化为一致视角变化、长时序自回归生成中的场景一致性与身份漂移（风格/颜色漂移），以及在不损失质量与可控性的前提下实现实时流式交互的低延迟。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 方法包括多源数据引擎（带精确相机位姿的UE5、恢复几何的真实视频和游戏数据）、渐进式训练管线（E-PRoPE相机控制、误差注入的记忆条件、事件指令调优、DMD-forcing蒸馏、保守的DiffusionNFT RL对齐）以及推理加速（INT8/FP8量化、序列并行、剪枝VAE解码、TeaCache残差复用和异步流水线并行）。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** 在5秒基础评测中，DreamX-World-1.0-5B相机控制得分为73.75、总分84.76，超过HY-WorldPlay 1.5（80.79）和LingBot-World（80.45）；在30秒长时序评测中以70.41领先；在记忆回访一致性中像素、感知、语义和位置识别指标均最优；人工偏好中总体胜率57.5%–61.9%；系统可在8张RTX 5090 GPU上达到最高16 FPS。

question1.question: For a 5-second 720P video, E-PRoPE downsamples the PRoPE attention input tokens from 18,480 to 4,096. What is the resulting spatial downsampling ratio, and what is the approximate inference latency reduction compared to the full PRoPE?
question1.option1: Approximately 4.5× downsampling ratio with ~30% lower inference latency
question1.option2: Approximately 8.0× downsampling ratio with ~50% lower inference latency
question1.option3: Approximately 2.0× downsampling ratio with ~15% lower inference latency

question2.question: In the memory consistency evaluation, which of the three trajectory templates is specifically designed to introduce heading changes and test place-identity preservation under viewpoint variation?
question2.option1: Out-and-back trajectory (D·D·D → A·A·A)
question2.option2: Closed-loop trajectory that returns to the exact starting pose
question2.option3: Translation–rotation trajectory (W·S·L·R·R·L·L)

question3.question: Which of the following inference optimization techniques is NOT mentioned in the DreamX-World 1.0 inference acceleration section?
question3.option1: INT8 SageAttention for attention layers with FP8 FFN quantization via AngelSlim
question3.option2: 75%-pruned VAE decoder with height-split parallel decoding following ParaVAE
question3.option3: Knowledge distillation applied to the VAE encoder to compress it for serving

question1.question: 对于一段5秒的720P视频，E-PRoPE将PRoPE注意力输入的token从18,480下采样到4,096。其空间下采样比例是多少？与完整PRoPE相比，推理延迟大约降低了多少？
question1.option1: 约4.5×下采样比例，推理延迟降低约30%
question1.option2: 约8.0×下采样比例，推理延迟降低约50%
question1.option3: 约2.0×下采样比例，推理延迟降低约15%

question2.question: 在记忆一致性评估中，三种轨迹模板中的哪一种专门用于引入航向变化，并测试在视点变化下的地点身份保持能力？
question2.option1: 往返轨迹（D·D·D → A·A·A）
question2.option2: 闭环轨迹，精确返回起始位姿
question2.option3: 平移-旋转轨迹（W·S·L·R·R·L·L）

question3.question: 以下哪项推理优化技术没有在DreamX-World 1.0的推理加速章节中被提及？
question3.option1: 注意力层使用INT8 SageAttention，FFN层使用AngelSlim进行FP8量化
question3.option2: 采用75%剪枝的VAE解码器，并按ParaVAE进行高度分片并行解码
question3.option3: 对VAE编码器应用知识蒸馏以压缩其体积用于服务部署

title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on developing compact small language models (SLMs) with strong verifiable reasoning capabilities in the domain of artificial intelligence and natural language processing.
2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** It builds upon the VibeThinker-1.5B work and its Spectrum-to-Signal Principle, proposing the new Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis that distinguishes compressible reasoning cores from parameter-expansive knowledge capabilities.
3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the challenge of pushing verifiable reasoning capabilities into a strict 3B parameter budget, challenging the conventional belief that frontier-level reasoning requires models with tens or hundreds of billions of parameters.
4. **🛠️ Methods:** The paper employs a multi-stage post-training pipeline including curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning with MaxEnt-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), Long2Short Math RL for efficiency, offline self-distillation, Instruct RL, and Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR) for test-time scaling.
5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** VibeThinker-3B achieves 94.3 on AIME26 (97.1 with CLR), 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, 96.1% acceptance rate on recent LeetCode contests, and 93.4 on IFEval, matching or exceeding flagship models like DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, Kimi K2.5, and Gemini 3 Pro that are orders of magnitude larger.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文聚焦于开发具有强大可验证推理能力的小型语言模型（SLM），属于人工智能与自然语言处理领域。
2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 该研究基于其前作 VibeThinker-1.5B 及其"谱到信号"原理（Spectrum-to-Signal Principle），并提出了新的参数压缩-覆盖假说（Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis），区分了可压缩的推理核心与参数密集型知识能力。
3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了在严格 3B 参数预算下实现前沿可验证推理能力的难题，挑战了传统观点所认为的前沿级推理必须依赖数千亿参数模型的假设。
4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文采用多阶段后训练流水线，包括基于课程学习的监督微调（SFT）、使用最大熵引导策略优化（MGPO）的多领域强化学习、用于提升效率的 Long2Short 数学 RL、离线自蒸馏、指令 RL，以及用于测试时缩放的声明级可靠性评估（CLR）。
5. **📊 结果与评估：** VibeThinker-3B 在 AIME26 上取得 94.3 分（使用 CLR 提升至 97.1），LiveCodeBench v6 上 Pass@1 达到 80.2，最近 LeetCode 竞赛接受率 96.1%，IFEval 取得 93.4 分，性能可与参数量大数个数量级的 DeepSeek V3.2、GLM-5、Kimi K2.5 和 Gemini 3 Pro 等旗舰模型相媲美甚至超越。

title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper studies efficient test-time computation scaling for code large language models, specifically focusing on Parallel Loop Transformers (PLT) and loop-count selection in the domain of code intelligence and natural language processing.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The work builds on Parallel Loop Transformers (PLT), which use cross-loop position offsets (CLP) and shared-KV gated sliding-window attention to enable efficient depth recurrence. The new idea is reframing loop-count selection as a gain-cost trade-off, where marginal refinement gains compete against a fixed CLP-induced positional mismatch cost, and using per-loop interpretability diagnostics to identify the saturation point.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses why Parallel Loop Transformers' performance exhibits non-monotonic behavior with respect to loop count—specifically, why additional loops beyond a certain point degrade performance rather than improve it, and how to determine the optimal loop count without exhaustive benchmarking.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The authors train a family of 7B PLT coders (LoopCoder-v2) from scratch on 18T tokens with matched loop counts (R∈{1,2,3,4}), then apply per-loop diagnostic lenses including hidden-state dynamics (step size, angular change, effective rank, fixed-point gap), attention heat-map evolution (entropy, KL divergence, head diversity, G-SWA gating), and output-distribution shift (logit-lens rank, KL divergence, entropy), along with an intrinsic offset cost metric Ω(t) to quantify CLP-induced positional mismatch.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** The two-loop variant (r=2) proves optimal, improving SWE-bench Verified from 43.0 to 64.4 and Multi-SWE from 14.0 to 31.0 points, while three-loop and four-loop variants regress (e.g., dropping to 27.6 and 22.4 on SWE-bench Verified). Diagnostic analysis shows loop 2 provides the main productive refinement with peak effective rank and largest output shift, while later loops yield diminishing, oscillatory updates against a roughly fixed offset cost. Additionally, explicit chain-of-thought and latent loop refinement are shown to be super-additively complementary (+26.9 on LiveCodeBench).
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 论文研究了代码大语言模型的高效测试时计算扩展，专注于并行循环 Transformer（PLT）及循环次数选择问题，属于代码智能与自然语言处理领域。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 研究基于并行循环 Transformer（PLT），该架构通过跨循环位置偏移（CLP）和共享 KV 的门控滑动窗口注意力实现高效的深度递归。新思路是将循环次数选择重构为收益-成本权衡，其中边际精化收益与固定的 CLP 位置错配成本相互竞争，并通过逐循环可解释性诊断来识别饱和点。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解释了为什么并行循环 Transformer 的性能相对于循环次数呈非单调变化——具体而言，为什么超过一定数量的额外循环会导致性能下降而非提升，以及如何在不进行详尽基准测试的情况下确定最优循环次数。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 作者在 18T tokens 上从头训练了一族 7B PLT 编码器（LoopCoder-v2），循环次数匹配（R∈{1,2,3,4}），然后应用逐循环诊断工具，包括隐藏状态动态（步长、角度变化、有效秩、不动点差距）、注意力热力图演化（熵、KL 散度、注意力头多样性、G-SWA 门控）以及输出分布变化（logit-lens 排名、KL 散度、熵），并引入内部偏移成本指标 Ω(t) 来量化 CLP 引起的位置错配。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** 双循环变体（r=2）证明是最优的，将 SWE-bench Verified 从 43.0 提升至 64.4，Multi-SWE 从 14.0 提升至 31.0 分，而三循环和四循环变体出现退化（例如在 SWE-bench Verified 上分别降至 27.6 和 22.4）。诊断分析表明循环 2 提供了主要的有效精化，具有峰值有效秩和最大输出变化，而后续循环在几乎固定的偏移成本下产生递减的、振荡式的更新。此外，显式思维链和潜在循环精化被证明是超加性地互补的（在 LiveCodeBench 上提升 26.9 分）。

question1.question: Why does the two-loop variant (r=2) of LoopCoder-v2 achieve the best performance across code benchmarks?
question1.option1: Because loop 2 is where effective rank peaks and provides the largest coherent refinement, including the highest inter-loop attention divergence and the greatest output-distribution shift
question1.option2: Because three or more loops cause the model to run out of GPU memory during inference
question1.option3: Because two loops allow the model to fully utilize all 7B parameters without any sharing

question2.question: What does the intrinsic offset cost Ω(t) defined in Equation 6 of the paper measure?
question2.option1: The mean Euclidean distance between adjacent token representations at the previous loop, quantifying the CLP-induced positional mismatch
question2.option2: The total number of training tokens processed per loop iteration
question2.option3: The cumulative cross-entropy loss accumulated across all loops during fine-tuning

question3.question: According to Table 4, what is the relationship between explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and latent loop refinement in LoopCoder-v2?
question3.option1: They are super-additively complementary: combining explicit CoT with latent loops yields gains (e.g., +26.9 on LiveCodeBench) exceeding the sum of each component's individual contribution
question3.option2: They are mutually exclusive: adding explicit CoT to a looped model always degrades its latent reasoning capability
question3.option3: They are redundant: explicit CoT alone achieves the same performance as the combination of CoT and latent loops

question1.question: 为什么LoopCoder-v2的两循环变体（r=2）在所有代码基准测试中表现最佳？
question1.option1: 因为循环2是有效秩达到峰值的地方，提供了最大的连贯性优化，包括最高的循环间注意力散度和最大的输出分布偏移
question1.option2: 因为三个或更多循环会导致模型在推理过程中耗尽GPU内存
question1.option3: 因为两个循环允许模型在没有任何参数共享的情况下充分利用所有70亿参数

question2.question: 论文公式6中定义的内在偏移成本Ω(t)衡量的是什么？
question2.option1: 上一循环中相邻token表示之间的平均欧几里得距离，用于量化CLP引起的位置失配
question2.option2: 每个循环迭代中处理的训练token总数
question2.option3: 微调过程中所有循环累积的总交叉熵损失

question3.question: 根据表4，在LoopCoder-v2中，显式思维链（CoT）推理与潜在循环优化之间的关系是什么？
question3.option1: 它们是超加性互补的：将显式CoT与潜在循环结合所产生的增益（例如在LiveCodeBench上+26.9）超过了各组成部分单独贡献之和
question3.option2: 它们是互斥的：在循环模型中添加显式CoT总是会降低其潜在推理能力
question3.option3: 它们是冗余的：仅使用显式CoT就能达到与CoT和潜在循环组合相同的性能

title: GameCraft-Bench: Can Agents Build Playable Games End-to-End in a Real Game Engine?
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper introduces GameCraft-Bench, a benchmark in the domain of AI coding agents and automated game generation, focused on evaluating whether agents can build playable end-to-end games in the Godot game engine.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The work builds on existing game generation benchmarks (OpenGame-Bench, GameDevBench, WebGameBench) and coding-agent frameworks, and introduces the new idea of three desiderata—Engine Grounding, Artifact Completeness, and Interactive Verification—jointly enforced through replayable interaction traces and rubric-guided multimodal judging.

3.  **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the lack of a rigorous benchmark that can evaluate whether coding agents can transform natural-language specifications into complete, launchable, and genuinely playable games in a real engine, rather than partial artifacts or static outputs.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** The authors construct a 140-task benchmark across 15 game families in Godot 4, require agents to submit a complete project plus replayable JSON interaction traces, then use a build-gate, headless replay with ffmpeg, and a multimodal LLM judge (GPT-5.5) to score games along four rubric categories—Core Mechanics, Content Depth, Functional Visuals, and Art & Presentation.

5.  **📊 Results and Evaluation:** Evaluating seven frontier coding agents shows end-to-end game generation remains far from solved: the best agent (Opus-4.7 high) reaches only 41.46%, most agents score below 40%, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro scores just 2.15%; agents more often implement recognizable mechanics than deliver complete, visually coherent, and content-rich games, and tool-usage volume is found to be a weak predictor of playability.
content_zh:
1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文介绍了 GameCraft-Bench，属于 AI 编程智能体与自动化游戏生成领域，专注于评估智能体是否能在 Godot 游戏引擎中端到端地构建可玩的游戏。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 该工作建立在现有游戏生成基准（OpenGame-Bench、GameDevBench、WebGameBench）及编程智能体框架的基础上，并提出了新思路：通过三大设计准则（引擎原生性、产物完整性、交互式验证）以及可回放交互轨迹与基于评分标准的多模态评判来联合实现严格评估。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了现有基准无法严谨评估编程智能体能否将自然语言规范转化为完整、可启动且真正可玩的真实引擎游戏的问题，避免只评价部分产物或静态输出。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** 作者在 Godot 4 中构建了涵盖 15 个游戏家族、共 140 个任务的基准，要求智能体提交完整项目及可回放的 JSON 交互轨迹，再通过构建门禁、无头回放与 ffmpeg 录屏，以及多模态 LLM 评判器（GPT-5.5）从核心机制、内容深度、功能性视觉、艺术与表现四个评分维度进行打分。

5.  **📊 结果与评估：** 对七种前沿编程智能体的评估表明端到端游戏生成远未解决：表现最佳的 Opus-4.7 high 仅获 41.46%，大多数智能体得分低于 40%，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仅得 2.15%；智能体常能实现可识别的局部机制，但难以交付完整、视觉协调且内容丰富的游戏，且工具调用量与可玩性之间相关性很弱。

title: OPD-Evolver: Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via On-Policy Distillation
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on self-evolving LLM-based agents, specifically proposing a framework for training agents that can holistically improve through experience management and lifelong learning in interactive environments.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on memory-augmented agents, skill libraries, and on-policy distillation (OPD) methods, but introduces a new idea: jointly cultivating four coupled capabilities (selection, execution, writing, management) through a slow-fast co-evolution framework with outcome-calibrated memory attribution and privileged hindsight distillation.

3.  **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the under-specified notion of "self-evolution" in agents, where existing systems typically optimize only one fragment of the experience lifecycle and lack holistic competence in selecting, using, writing, and managing experience for sustained behavioral improvement.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** The paper proposes OPD-Evolver, a slow-fast co-evolution framework featuring a fast loop for online four-level memory hierarchy interaction (trajectories, tips, skills, tools) and a slow loop that distills outcome-calibrated memory attribution and privileged hindsight into the deployable policy via on-policy self-distillation with token-level KL divergence.

5.  **📊 Results and Evaluation:** OPD-Evolver-4B/9B surpasses memory systems like ReasoningBank by up to 11.5% and training-based methods like Skill0 by ~5.8%, with OPD-Evolver-9B challenging giant counterparts like QWEN3.5-397B-A17B on multiple benchmarks including AMA-Bench, MemoryArena, LifelongAgentBench, and InterCode.

1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 论文聚焦于基于LLM的自演化智能体，具体提出了一个通过经验管理和终身学习在交互环境中实现整体自我提升的智能体训练框架。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文建立在记忆增强智能体、技能库和在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法的基础上，但提出了一个新思路：通过慢-快协同演化框架，结合结果校准的记忆归因和特权事后蒸馏，联合培养四种耦合能力（选择、执行、写入、管理）。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了智能体"自演化"概念定义不明确的问题，现有系统通常只优化经验生命周期的一个片段，缺乏在选择、使用、写入和管理经验方面进行持续行为改进的整体能力。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** 论文提出了OPD-Evolver，一个慢-快协同演化框架，具有用于在线四级记忆层次（轨迹、提示、技能、工具）交互的快循环，以及通过带token级KL散度的在线策略自蒸馏，将结果校准的记忆归因和特权事后信号蒸馏到可部署策略中的慢循环。

5.  **📊 结果与评估：** OPD-Evolver-4B/9B比ReasoningBank等记忆系统高出最多11.5%，比Skill0等基于训练的方法高出约5.8%，其中OPD-Evolver-9B在AMA-Bench、MemoryArena、LifelongAgentBench和InterCode等多个基准测试中能够挑战QWEN3.5-397B-A17B等巨型模型。

title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in controllable non-Markov game environments, specifically targeting their ability to reconstruct past observations and act on them during multi-step interactive tasks, which lies at the intersection of multimodal AI, agent evaluation, and memory benchmarking.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on prior game-based benchmarks (e.g., GameBench, BALROG, GameWorld) and long-context/memory benchmarks (e.g., EMemBench, LongBench, RULER), but identifies that none isolates the "remember-to-act" non-Markov regime. Its new idea is to introduce RNG-Bench with two complementary games (Matching Pairs for static identity-location memory and 3D Maze for dynamic spatial memory), a duel protocol for instance-level variance control, and a Memory Gap metric to disentangle forgetting from action selection errors.

3.  **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the lack of benchmarks that isolate MLLMs' ability to maintain and act on hidden state reconstructed from in-context history, distinguishing it from rule understanding, perception, planning, and output formatting, particularly in closed-loop settings where recall errors causally affect subsequent observations.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** The paper constructs two POMDP-based game environments with controlled difficulty axes (grid size, visual pattern, observation modality), evaluates frontier MLLMs (GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, Kimi-K2.5, Seed-2.0-Lite) under a unified harness, introduces a duel protocol and Memory Gap metric via oracle state injection, and performs supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-9B on optimal-policy rollouts and filtered model demonstrations to test transfer.

5.  **📊 Results and Evaluation:** Results show frontier MLLMs remain far from saturated (e.g., GPT-5.4 achieves only 62.3% on 10×10 Matching Pairs and 20% SR on 13×3D Maze), performance drops sharply as hidden state grows, image observation (not just history length) drives the bottleneck, Memory Gap analysis localizes most residual errors to forgetting rather than decision making, and fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B improves performance on RNG-Bench and transfers to external memory/spatial benchmarks (+3.4 group mean) without degrading general multimodal capability.

1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 论文聚焦于在可控的非马尔可夫博弈环境中评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM），具体针对其在多步交互任务中重建过往观察并据此行动的能力，属于多模态AI、智能体评估与记忆基准测试交叉领域。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于已有游戏基准（如GameBench、BALROG、GameWorld）和长上下文/记忆基准（如EMemBench、LongBench、RULER），但指出它们都无法孤立地测试"为行动而记忆"的非马尔可夫场景。其新思路在于提出RNG-Bench，包含互补的两款游戏（Matching Pairs测试静态身份-位置记忆，3D Maze测试动态空间记忆）、用于控制实例差异的对决协议，以及通过记忆差距（Memory Gap）指标将遗忘与动作选择错误分离。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 论文旨在解决现有基准无法孤立评估MLLM在上下文历史中重建并利用隐藏状态进行行动的能力这一问题，将其与规则理解、感知、规划和输出格式等因素区分开，尤其是在召回错误因果影响后续观察的闭环场景中。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** 论文构建了两个基于POMDP的博弈环境，具有可控难度轴（网格大小、视觉模式、观察模态），在统一评测框架下评估GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1-Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、Kimi-K2.5、Seed-2.0-Lite等前沿MLLM，引入对决协议和通过Oracle状态注入的记忆差距指标，并对Qwen3.5-9B在最优策略回放和筛选后的模型演示上进行监督微调以测试迁移能力。

5.  **📊 结果与评估：** 结果显示前沿MLLM远未饱和（例如GPT-5.4在10×10 Matching Pairs上仅获62.3%，在13×13 3D Maze上仅20%成功率），性能随隐藏状态增大急剧下降，图像观察（而非历史长度）是主要瓶颈，记忆差距分析表明大部分残留错误源于遗忘而非决策失误，对Qwen3.5-9B的微调提升了RNG-Bench性能并迁移到外部记忆/空间基准（组均值+3.4），且未削弱通用多模态能力。

title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** This paper focuses on on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) for diffusion large language models (dLLMs), situated in the intersection of machine learning, natural language processing, and post-training optimization for reasoning tasks.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The work builds upon on-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) methods developed for autoregressive (AR) LLMs (e.g., [Agarwal et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2026; Lu and Lab, 2025]) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) approaches for dLLMs (e.g., diffu-GRPO [Zhao et al., 2025]). The new idea is to reframe self-distillation for dLLMs by leveraging their bidirectional generation capability—using self-generated answers as suffix conditioning (rather than prefix) and shifting from token-level to step-level divergence supervision to align with the iterative denoising nature of dLLMs.

3.  **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the incompatibility of existing AR-centric OPSD formulations with dLLMs' arbitrary-order generation. Specifically, it tackles two issues: (1) the suboptimal self-teacher construction that relies on left-to-right prefix conditioning with static reference solutions, and (2) the unsuitability of token-level divergence supervision for dLLMs' simultaneous masked-token prediction paradigm. It also aims to overcome the sparse-reward bottleneck of RLVR and the exposure bias of SFT.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** The proposed framework, d-OPSD, introduces (1) a self-teacher construction that uses self-generated on-policy answers as suffix privileged information via selective token revealing with a retaining ratio ρ_teacher, and (2) step-level KL divergence supervision applied to the top-k most confident masked positions across the entire T-step denoising trajectory. The method uses reverse KL with pointwise clipping (threshold 0.05), LoRA fine-tuning (rank 128, α=64), a fixed teacher policy, and a pass@k sampling strategy (k=8) to retain only correct generations for loss computation.

5.  **📊 Results and Evaluation:** Evaluated on four reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, Countdown, and 4x4 Sudoku) using LLaDA-8B-Instruct, d-OPSD consistently outperforms or matches SFT and RLVR baselines. For example, on GSM8K it achieves 81.0% (vs. 79.8% for diffu-GRPO), on Countdown 37.9% (vs. 33.2%), and on Sudoku 23.9% (vs. 18.4%). It demonstrates vastly superior sample efficiency, requiring only ~10% of RLVR's optimization steps (e.g., 425 vs. 7700 steps on GSM8K). Ablation studies confirm the superiority of reverse KL over forward KL, teacher-derived K_t selection, the default ρ_teacher=0.25, and pointwise clipping. A noted failure mode is policy collapse after peak performance, similar to RLVR.
content_zh:
1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 本文聚焦于扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD），属于机器学习、自然语言处理以及推理任务后训练优化交叉领域的研究。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 该工作基于自回归大语言模型的OPSD和OPD方法（如Agarwal等人2024年、Zhao等人2026年、Lu和Lab 2025年的工作）以及dLLMs的RLVR方法（如diffu-GRPO [Zhao等人2025]）。新思路在于通过利用dLLMs的双向生成能力重构自蒸馏框架——将自生成的答案用作后缀条件（而非前缀），并将监督从token级转移至步骤级，以契合dLLMs迭代去噪的本质特征。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了现有面向自回归模型的OPSD方法与dLLMs任意顺序生成特性不兼容的问题。具体包括两方面：(1) 现有自教师构建依赖从左到右的前缀条件和静态参考解，对dLLMs而言是次优的；(2) token级散度监督与dLLMs同时预测多个掩码token的范式不匹配。该工作还旨在克服RLVR的稀疏奖励瓶颈和SFT的曝光偏差问题。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** 所提出的d-OPSD框架引入了两个核心组件：(1) 自教师构建——通过以保留率ρ_teacher选择性揭示自生成的答案作为后缀特权信息；(2) 步骤级KL散度监督——应用于整个T步去噪轨迹中当前掩码位置置信度最高的top-k个token。该方法使用反向KL配合逐点裁剪（阈值0.05）、LoRA微调（秩128，α=64）、固定的教师策略，以及pass@k采样策略（k=8），仅对正确生成样本计算损失。

5.  **📊 结果与评估：** 基于LLaDA-8B-Instruct在四个推理基准（GSM8K、MATH500、Countdown、4x4数独）上的评估，d-OPSD持续优于或匹配SFT和RLVR基线。例如在GSM8K上达到81.0%（对比diffu-GRPO的79.8%），Countdown上为37.9%（对比33.2%），数独上为23.9%（对比18.4%）。该方法展现出卓越的样本效率，仅需RLVR约10%的优化步数（如GSM8K上425步对比7700步）。消融实验验证了反向KL优于正向KL、采用教师分布确定K_t、默认ρ_teacher=0.25及逐点裁剪的优势。一个值得注意的失败模式是在达到峰值性能后会出现策略崩溃，类似于RLVR的现象。

question1.question: According to the paper, what is the key mechanism that allows d-OPSD's self-teacher construction to outperform the AR-style OPSD counterpart on reasoning tasks?
question1.option1: d-OPSD uses a larger pretrained teacher model that provides more accurate next-token distributions.
question1.option2: d-OPSD leverages bidirectional generation with self-generated suffixes, yielding a lower Overlap Top-K that introduces more new thinking patterns to transfer to the student.
question1.option3: d-OPSD applies a higher retaining ratio ρ_teacher that exposes the student to more privileged tokens per step.

question2.question: In d-OPSD, the top-k subset K_t is derived from the teacher distribution rather than the student distribution. What is the main reason this design choice yields better performance according to the ablation results?
question2.option1: It forces the student to align with the teacher's most confident predictions, providing a stronger and more focused learning signal.
question2.option2: It significantly reduces GPU memory consumption during the iterative denoising process.
question2.option3: It prevents the student model from being influenced by incorrect trajectories generated early in training.

question3.question: Which failure mode is explicitly reported for d-OPSD in Section 4.5, and how does it relate to behaviors observed in RLVR?
question3.option1: d-OPSD suffers from gradient explosion due to unstable KL divergence, whereas RLVR never encounters this issue.
question3.option2: d-OPSD is prone to policy collapse after reaching peak performance, mirroring a similar phenomenon commonly observed in RLVR.
question3.option3: d-OPSD fails to converge on long sequences and exhibits NaN losses, while RLVR remains stable across all generation lengths.

question1.question: 根据论文, d-OPSD的自教师构建方式在推理任务上优于AR风格OPSD对应方法的关键机制是什么?
question1.option1: d-OPSD使用了更大的预训练教师模型, 从而提供更准确的下一个词元分布。
question1.option2: d-OPSD利用双向生成能力并采用自生成的后缀作为条件, 使得Overlap Top-K更低, 从而引入更多新的思维模式传递给学生模型。
question1.option3: d-OPSD采用了更高的保留比例ρ_teacher, 使得学生在每一步能接触到更多的特权词元。

question2.question: 在d-OPSD中, top-k子集K_t从教师分布而非学生分布中推导得出。消融实验显示这种设计选择带来更好性能的主要原因是?
question2.option1: 它迫使学生与教师最自信的预测对齐, 提供了更强且更聚焦的学习信号。
question2.option2: 它显著降低了迭代去噪过程中的GPU内存消耗。
question2.option3: 它阻止学生模型受到训练早期生成的不正确轨迹的影响。

question3.question: 第4.5节明确报告的d-OPSD的失败模式是什么? 它与RLVR中观察到的行为有何关联?
question3.option1: d-OPSD由于KL散度不稳定而遭受梯度爆炸, 而RLVR则从未遇到此类问题。
question3.option2: d-OPSD在达到峰值性能后容易发生策略崩溃, 这与RLVR中常见的类似现象相一致。
question3.option3: d-OPSD在长序列上无法收敛并出现NaN损失, 而RLVR在所有生成长度上均保持稳定。

title: JoyAI-VL-Interaction: Real-Time Vision-Language Interaction Intelligence
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper belongs to the field of multimodal AI, specifically vision-language models (VLMs) and real-time human-AI interaction, introducing a new "interaction model" paradigm for streaming, proactive AI assistance.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on turn-based real-time omni models (e.g., GPT-Realtime-2, Qwen3.5-Omni), consumer video-call products (Doubao, Gemini), TML's interaction models, full-duplex speech systems (MoshiRAG), and streaming video understanding research; its new idea is to make "when to speak" a learned, per-second in-model decision with silence, response, and delegation as first-class actions, while making vision the primary driver in a compact ~8B model and open-sourcing the entire stack.

3. **❓ Problem:** Existing large models are structurally turn-based—they only respond when addressed—making them unable to perceive and act on real-time events in the physical world (e.g., fires, falls, key moments) before the moment passes, since the world does not pause for a user to ask.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The authors build an 8B vision-language model on JoyAI-VL 1.0 (Qwen3-8B + Qwen3-VL ViT), use AdaCodec for efficient video tokenization, construct >4M time-aligned clips across six capability families with multi-level verification, train with a weighted SFT loss (reweighting silence/response tokens) followed by GRPO reinforcement learning, and deploy a complete system with a three-tier hierarchical memory, vLLM-native serving, pluggable ASR/TTS, and a background delegation bridge supporting two concurrent loops.

5. **📊 Results:** In head-to-head human evaluations across six real-world streaming scenarios (58 cases), JoyAI-VL-Interaction is preferred over Doubao's and Gemini's in-app video-call assistants with 77.6% and 87.9% win rates respectively, winning 100% of monitoring/alerting comparisons against both, demonstrating sub-second latency over 2+ hours, and exhibiting emergent capabilities (e.g., app guidance, improvised lecture) not present in the training data.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 论文属于多模态人工智能领域，具体聚焦于视觉-语言模型（VLM）与实时人机交互，提出了一种用于流式、主动式AI辅助的新型"交互模型"范式。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于轮次制实时全模态模型（如GPT-Realtime-2、Qwen3.5-Omni）、消费级视频通话产品（Doubao、Gemini）、TML的交互模型、全双工语音系统（MoshiRAG）以及流媒体视频理解研究；其新思路在于将"何时发声"作为模型自身学习的逐秒决策，使沉默、回应和委派成为一等公民动作，同时让视觉成为紧凑约80亿参数模型的主要驱动，并开源整个技术栈。

3. **❓ 问题：** 现有大模型在结构上都是轮次制的——只在被询问时才会响应——因此无法在物理世界的实时事件（如火灾、跌倒、关键时刻）发生的当下进行感知和行动，因为世界不会停下来等待用户提问。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 作者在JoyAI-VL 1.0（Qwen3-8B + Qwen3-VL ViT）之上构建了一个80亿参数的视觉-语言模型，使用AdaCodec进行高效视频标记化，构建了跨越六类能力、经过多级验证的超过400万条时间对齐片段，训练时采用加权SFT损失（对沉默/回应标记重新加权）并结合GRPO强化学习，最后部署了一个包含三层分层记忆、vLLM原生服务、可插拔ASR/TTS以及支持两个并发循环的后台委派桥接器的完整系统。

5. **📊 结果：** 在六个真实流媒体场景（58个案例）的头对头人工评估中，JoyAI-VL-Interaction相比Doubao和Gemini的应用内视频通话助手分别取得了77.6%和87.9%的胜率，在监控告警场景中对两者均取得100%胜率，可实现2小时以上亚秒级延迟，并展现出训练数据中未出现的涌现能力（如App引导、即兴讲座等）。

title: S-Agent: Spatial Tool-Use Elicits Reasoning for Spatial Intelligence
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on spatial intelligence in vision-language models (VLMs), specifically agentic AI for continuous multi-view image and video spatial reasoning in computer vision.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** Building on prior agentic VLM frameworks (VADAR, SpaceTools) and spatial-specialized models (Cambrian-S, SenseNova-SI), the paper introduces the new idea of reformulating spatial reasoning as iterative spatio-temporal evidence accumulation rather than single-shot frame-level prediction.

3.  **❓ Problem:** It addresses the semantic-to-geometric gap in existing VLMs—namely, their inability to maintain persistent object states, integrate evidence across viewpoints and time, and perform stateful reasoning over continuous multi-view or video inputs beyond static, stateless inference.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** S-Agent uses a VLM as a semantic planner that invokes a three-level hierarchy of spatial tools/experts (2D visual grounding, 2D-to-3D geometric lifting via Depth-Anything-3, and specialized spatial experts for counting, measurement, orientation, and relations), together with a dual-memory system (Scene Memory for entity tracking and Agent Memory for reasoning history); trajectories are distilled into the S-300K dataset to fine-tune a compact S-Agent-8B via supervised learning.

5.  **📊 Results and Evaluation:** S-Agent achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance with 46.4% on MMSI-Bench (+1.2% over Gemini 3 Pro, +4.5% over GPT-5.4), 60.0% on ViewSpatial-Bench, and 58.8 on ReVSI; the fine-tuned S-Agent-8B improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 10.5% on MMSI-Bench (31.1%→41.6%) and rivals GPT-5.4/Gemini 3 Pro, with ablations confirming the necessity of Level-3 experts and dual memory.
content_zh:
1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文聚焦于视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间智能，具体属于计算机视觉领域中面向连续多视图图像与视频空间推理的智能体AI方向。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 基于现有智能体VLM框架（VADAR、SpaceTools）及空间专用模型（Cambrian-S、SenseNova-SI）的研究基础，提出将空间推理重新定义为时空证据累积的迭代过程，而非单次帧级预测的新思路。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 论文旨在解决现有VLM的语义-几何鸿沟问题，即无法跨视点和时间维持持久对象状态、整合证据，难以对连续多视图或视频输入进行有状态的推理，摆脱静态、无状态的推理局限。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** S-Agent采用VLM作为语义规划器，调用三级分层空间工具与专家（2D视觉定位、通过Depth-Anything-3实现的2D到3D几何提升，以及用于计数、测量、朝向和关系的空间专家），配合双记忆系统（用于实体追踪的场景记忆与用于推理历史的智能体记忆）；其轨迹被蒸馏为S-300K数据集，用于监督微调紧凑型S-Agent-8B。

5.  **📊 结果与评估：** S-Agent在零样本下取得领先性能，在MMSI-Bench上达到46.4%（较Gemini 3 Pro提升1.2%，较GPT-5.4提升4.5%），在ViewSpatial-Bench上为60.0%，在ReVSI上为58.8；微调后的S-Agent-8B使Qwen3-VL-8B在MMSI-Bench上提升10.5%（31.1%→41.6%），可与GPT-5.4和Gemini 3 Pro媲美，消融实验验证了三级专家和双记忆机制的必要性。

question1.question: In S-Agent's hierarchical spatial evidence framework, which level is responsible for abstracting 2D and 3D cues into high-level, scene-specific spatial knowledge such as object counts, orientations, and physical measurements?
question1.option1: Level 1: 2D Visual Evidence Acquisition
question1.option2: Level 2: 2D-to-3D Geometric Lifting
question1.option3: Level 3: Spatial Knowledge Aggregation

question2.question: According to the zero-shot results, what is S-Agent's average score on MMSI-Bench, and which model does it outperform to claim the top spot?
question2.option1: 41.9%, outperforming Gemini 3 Pro
question2.option2: 46.4%, outperforming Gemini 3 Pro by 1.2%
question2.option3: 45.2%, outperforming GPT-5.4 by 4.5%

question3.question: What is the purpose of decomposing S-Agent trajectories into final-answer, turn-level, and expert/tool trajectories during the construction of the S-300K dataset?
question3.option1: To increase the dataset size beyond 300K samples for better scaling
question3.option2: To convert a single teacher-agent rollout into multi-granularity training signals, teaching the student not only final answers but also how to request evidence and integrate spatial knowledge
question3.option3: To filter out trajectories that use tools, ensuring the student relies on internalized knowledge

question1.question: 在S-Agent的层次化空间证据框架中,哪一层负责将2D和3D线索抽象为高级的、场景特定的空间知识,如物体计数、朝向和物理测量?
question1.option1: 第一层:2D视觉证据获取
question1.option2: 第二层:2D到3D几何提升
question1.option3: 第三层:空间知识聚合

question2.question: 根据零样本结果,S-Agent在MMSI-Bench上的平均分是多少?它超越了哪个模型以获得第一名?
question2.option1: 41.9%,超越了Gemini 3 Pro
question2.option2: 46.4%,超越了Gemini 3 Pro 1.2个百分点
question2.option3: 45.2%,超越了GPT-5.4 4.5个百分点

question3.question: 在构建S-300K数据集时,将S-Agent轨迹分解为最终答案、轮次级别和专家/工具轨迹的目的是什么?
question3.option1: 将数据集规模扩展到30万以上以获得更好的规模化效果
question3.option2: 将单个教师-智能体的rollout转换为多粒度训练信号,教会学生模型不仅生成最终答案,还学会如何请求证据和整合空间知识
question3.option3: 过滤掉使用工具的轨迹,确保学生模型依赖内化的知识

title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting in computer vision and AI, with applications in robotics planning and video generation.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on classical motion perception work (Gibson, Ullman, Lucas-Kanade optical flow) and recent advances in point tracking (CoTracker, AllTracker) and 3D reconstruction (ViPE), as well as motion prediction methods using pixels, parametric 3D models, or 2D point trajectories. The new idea is using object-attached 3D points in world coordinates as a class-agnostic, view-stable, and compact representation for general motion forecasting.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses how to accurately forecast the future 3D trajectories of points on objects given a short visual history, initial query points, and a natural language action description—overcoming limitations of existing representations that are either category-specific, view-dependent, or lack physical grounding.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The paper introduces a full stack including: (1) MolmoMotion-1M, a 1.16M-video dataset with an automatic annotation pipeline using LLMs, MolmoPoint, SAM3, AllTracker, and ViPE; (2) PointMotionBench, a human-verified benchmark across 111 object categories; and (3) MolmoMotion, a model built on the Molmo2 backbone with two variants—an autoregressive coordinate predictor and a flow-matching trajectory generator.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** MolmoMotion significantly outperforms all baselines on PointMotionBench across ADE, FDE, and PWT metrics; in robotics, it improves pick-and-place success rate from 56.0% to 76.3% on MolmoSpaces and reduces trajectory error on DROID; in video generation, its predicted trajectories guide DaS to outperform much larger models like Wan2.2-I2V-A14B on most metrics.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文聚焦于计算机视觉和人工智能领域中以目标为条件的3D点运动预测，并应用于机器人规划和视频生成。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于经典运动感知研究（Gibson、Ullman、Lucas-Kanade光流法）以及近期在点跟踪（CoTracker、AllTracker）和3D重建（ViPE）方面的进展，还有使用像素、参数化3D模型或2D点轨迹的运动预测方法。新思路是采用世界坐标系中附着于物体的3D点作为一种类别无关、视角稳定且紧凑的表示方式，用于通用运动预测。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了如何根据简短视觉历史、初始查询点和自然语言动作描述准确预测物体上点的未来3D轨迹的问题，克服了现有表示方法的局限性，这些方法要么类别特定、依赖视角，要么缺乏物理基础。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文引入了一套完整的方法栈：(1) MolmoMotion-1M，一个包含116万个视频的数据集，使用LLM、MolmoPoint、SAM3、AllTracker和ViPE构建自动标注流程；(2) PointMotionBench，涵盖111个物体类别的人工验证基准；(3) MolmoMotion，基于Molmo2骨干网络的模型，包含两种变体——自回归坐标预测器和流匹配轨迹生成器。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** MolmoMotion在PointMotionBench上的ADE、FDE和PWT指标上显著优于所有基线方法；在机器人任务中，将MolmoSpaces上的抓放成功率从56.0%提升至76.3%，并在DROID上降低了轨迹误差；在视频生成中，其预测的轨迹可引导DaS在大多数指标上超越Wan2.2-I2V-A14B等更大的模型。

title: Moebius: 0.2B Lightweight Image Inpainting Framework with 10B-Level Performance
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** This paper focuses on image inpainting within computer vision and deep learning, specifically proposing a lightweight framework based on latent diffusion models.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds upon latent diffusion models (LDM), efficient architectures (DWConv, linear attention, Mix-FFN), and knowledge distillation. Its new ideas include the Local-λMix Interaction (LλMI) block with Local-λ and Interactive-λ modules that summarize contexts into fixed-size linear matrices, combined with an adaptive multi-granularity latent distillation strategy.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the prohibitive computational cost and deployment difficulty of 10B-level industrial inpainting models (e.g., FLUX.1-Fill-Dev), while naive compression causes severe representation bottlenecks.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The methods include: (1) the LλMI block integrating Local-λ (self-attention equivalent), Interactive-λ (cross-attention equivalent for LCG embeddings), and Mix-FFN; (2) Depthwise Residual Blocks for spatial feature extraction; and (3) an adaptive multi-granularity distillation strategy with coarse/fine-grained losses and latent perceptual loss, balanced via gradient-norm-based adaptive weights.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** Moebius achieves comparable or superior quality to FLUX.1-Fill-Dev with only 0.22B parameters (vs 11.9B), delivering >15× total inference speedup. It achieves leading FID scores (e.g., 0.92 on Places2 Small, 5.39 on CelebA-HQ, 8.15 on FFHQ), with user studies showing it matches its teacher PixelHacker and surpasses 10B-level industrial models.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文聚焦于计算机视觉与深度学习领域的图像修复（Image Inpainting），具体提出了一种基于潜在扩散模型的轻量化框架。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）、高效架构（DWConv、线性注意力、Mix-FFN）和知识蒸馏等先前研究；其新思路在于提出了Local-λMix Interaction（LλMI）模块（含Local-λ和Interactive-λ子模块，将上下文信息压缩为固定大小的线性矩阵），并结合自适应多粒度潜在空间蒸馏策略。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了10B级工业级图像修复模型（如FLUX.1-Fill-Dev）计算成本过高、难以实际部署的问题，以及直接压缩导致的表征能力严重退化（表征瓶颈）问题。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文采用的方法包括：（1）LλMI模块，集成Local-λ（自注意力等价）、Interactive-λ（用于LCG嵌入的交叉注意力等价）和Mix-FFN；（2）使用深度可分离残差块进行空间特征提取；（3）自适应多粒度蒸馏策略，包括粗粒度/细粒度蒸馏损失及潜在空间感知损失，通过基于梯度范数的自适应权重进行动态平衡。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** Moebius仅用0.22B参数（对比11.9B）即可达到与FLUX.1-Fill-Dev相当或更优的质量，总推理速度提升超15倍；在Places2 Small（FID 0.92）、CelebA-HQ（FID 5.39）、FFHQ（FID 8.15）等基准上取得领先成绩，用户研究表明其匹配教师模型PixelHacker并显著超越10B级工业模型。

question1.question: Why is the Interactive-λ module necessary in Moebius's LλMI block, even though Local-λ already provides a self-attention equivalent?
question1.option1: Because Gated Linear Attention (GLA) inherently lacks the mathematical formulation for cross-attention, and Moebius must integrate external LCG semantic priors
question1.option2: Because Local-λ cannot process features in the latent space at all
question1.option3: Because Mix-FFN is computationally too expensive for self-attention operations

question2.question: What is the distinguishing characteristic of Moebius's adaptive multi-granularity distillation strategy compared to conventional diffusion knowledge distillation?
question2.option1: It operates strictly within the latent space to avoid expensive pixel-space decoding, and dynamically balances heterogeneous losses using gradient-norm-based adaptive weights
question2.option2: It only uses the teacher's final noise prediction as the sole supervision signal without any auxiliary losses
question2.option3: It requires decoding latents back to the pixel space for every perceptual loss computation across all granularities

question3.question: On which benchmark does Moebius achieve an FID of 0.92, surpassing the 10B-level FLUX.1-Fill-Dev model?
question3.option1: Places2 (Small)
question3.option2: CelebA-HQ (512)
question3.option3: FFHQ (256)

question1.question: 既然Local-λ已经提供了自注意力等价功能,为什么Moebius的LλMI块中还需要Interactive-λ模块?

question1.option2: 因为Local-λ完全无法处理潜在空间中的特征
question1.option3: 因为Mix-FFN对自注意力操作而言计算成本过高

question2.question: 与传统的扩散模型知识蒸馏相比,Moebius的自适应多粒度蒸馏策略的显著特点是什么?

title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** This paper belongs to the domain of LLM evaluation and benchmarking, specifically focused on multilingual code generation assessment across diverse programming languages.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds upon LiveCodeBench (Jain et al., 2024), a contamination-aware Python-only code benchmark, and introduces the new idea of extending it to 12 programming languages through a unified STDIN/STDOUT format conversion pipeline.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the critical question of whether LLMs can generalize coding competence across multiple programming languages, rather than being overfitted to Python, which is the primary limitation of existing code benchmarks.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The authors designed an automatic conversion pipeline that transforms LeetCode's functional-format tasks into STDIN/STDOUT format, applied zero-shot prompting with language-specific system messages, and evaluated 24 LLMs using Pass@1 metric averaged over 10 runs with temperature 0.2.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** The evaluation revealed substantial performance gaps across languages (Python averaging ~48% vs Scala ~29%), evidence of Python overfitting, language-specific contamination patterns, and demonstrated that Python performance is not a reliable proxy for cross-lingual competence.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文属于大语言模型评估与基准测试领域，专注于多编程语言代码生成的综合评估。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于LiveCodeBench（Jain等人，2024年）这一污染感知的Python专用代码基准测试，并引入通过统一STDIN/STDOUT格式转换管道将其扩展至12种编程语言的新思路。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了LLM是否能够在多种编程语言间泛化编码能力（而非仅仅过拟合于Python）这一关键问题，这也是现有代码基准测试的主要局限性。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 作者设计了一个自动转换管道，将LeetCode的函数式格式任务转换为STDIN/STDOUT格式，采用包含语言特定系统消息的零样本提示策略，并使用10次平均的Pass@1指标（温度为0.2）对24个LLM进行评估。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** 评估揭示了跨语言间的显著性能差距（Python平均约48%对比Scala约29%），发现了Python过拟合、语言特定污染的证据，并证明Python性能并不能可靠代表跨语言编码能力。

question1.question: What is the main technical innovation that allows Multi-LCB to evaluate 12 programming languages uniformly?

title: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion language models, specifically targeting efficient fine-grained visual perception and parallel region captioning tasks in computer vision and multimodal AI.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The work builds on autoregressive region-specific MLLMs (DAM, GAR, PixelRefer) and discrete diffusion language models (LLaDA, LLaDA-V, MMaDA); its new idea is to leverage the inherent non-autoregressive parallel decoding nature of diffusion language models to jointly caption multiple image regions in a single denoising process.

3. **❓ Problem:** It addresses the linear growth in inference cost and latency of autoregressive MLLMs when perceiving and captioning multiple regions, as well as the underdeveloped perceptual capabilities and unexplored parallelism of existing multimodal diffusion language models.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The paper proposes PerceptionDLM-Base as a strong diffusion VLM baseline, then introduces a parallel region perception framework combining learnable region prompting, RoI-aligned feature replay, and structured attention masking, trained on the newly constructed ParaCaption-5.7M dataset and evaluated on the new ParaDLC-Bench.

5. **📊 Results:** PerceptionDLM achieves 62.4% average accuracy on ParaDLC-Bench (nearly doubling LLaDA-V's 35.2%), a Tokens-Per-Forward of 2.9 versus 1 for AR baselines, up to 3.5× throughput speedup in dense perception, and outperforms LLaDA-V on 15 of 16 multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive with AR region-specific models.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文聚焦于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与扩散语言模型领域，具体研究高效的细粒度视觉感知及多区域并行图像描述生成任务。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 该工作基于自回归区域专用模型（DAM、GAR、PixelRefer）和离散扩散语言模型（LLaDA、LLaDA-V、MMaDA）；其新思路是利用扩散语言模型固有的非自回归并行解码能力，在单次去噪过程中联合为多个图像区域生成描述。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文旨在解决自回归MLLMs在多区域感知中推理成本和延迟随区域数量线性增长的问题，以及现有多模态扩散语言模型感知能力不足且并行性未被充分挖掘的难题。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文首先构建了强大的扩散视觉语言模型基线PerceptionDLM-Base，随后提出结合可学习区域提示、RoI对齐特征回放和结构化注意力掩码的并行区域感知框架，并基于新构建的ParaCaption-5.7M数据集训练、在新提出的ParaDLC-Bench基准上进行评估。

5. **📊 结果：** PerceptionDLM在ParaDLC-Bench上达到62.4%的平均准确率（几乎是LLaDA-V 35.2%的两倍），Tokens-Per-Forward为2.9（自回归基线为1），在密集感知场景下吞吐量加速高达3.5倍，并在16个多模态基准中的15个上超越LLaDA-V，同时与自回归区域专用模型保持有竞争力的性能。

title: Playful Agentic Robot Learning
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on Playful Agentic Robot Learning, combining robotics, agentic AI, and continual skill acquisition through Code-as-Policy frameworks.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** It builds on Code-as-Policy (CaP) agents, developmental robotics, and intrinsic motivation (curiosity-driven learning), proposing the new idea of using self-directed play as a pre-deployment skill-acquisition stage for agentic robots.

3. **❓ Problem:** Current agentic robot systems remain task-driven, acquiring reusable skills only after receiving explicit instructions, lacking a proactive mechanism for accumulating capabilities before downstream tasks arrive.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The paper introduces RATS (Robotics Agent Teams), a multi-agent system with a Task Proposer (using a Goldilocks novelty-learnability rule), an Execution team (Planner, Policy Writer, Verifier, Diagnoser), and a Memory-Management team, all engaging in autonomous play to distill successful executions into a reusable Code-as-Policy skill library.

5. **📊 Results:** RATS achieves 20.6 and 17.0 percentage-point gains over CaP-Agent0 on LIBERO-PRO and MolmoSpaces respectively, with learned skills transferring to RoboSuite (+8.9 pp) and real-world tasks (+8.8 pp) without fine-tuning the underlying model.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文聚焦于"玩趣式智能体机器人学习"（Playful Agentic Robot Learning），融合机器人技术、智能体AI与基于代码即策略（Code-as-Policy）的持续技能习得。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 基于代码即策略（CaP）智能体、发展型机器人学与内在动机驱动的好奇心学习，提出新思路——将自主游戏作为下游任务到来前的预先技能习得阶段。

3. **❓ 问题：** 当前智能体机器人系统仍以任务驱动为主，仅在收到外部指令后才习得可复用技能，缺乏在下游任务出现前主动积累能力的机制。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文提出RATS（机器人智能体团队），一个多智能体系统，包含任务提议者（采用"金发姑娘"新奇-可学习性规则）、执行团队（规划器、策略生成器、验证器、诊断器）和记忆管理团队，通过自主游戏将成功执行提炼为可复用的代码技能库。

5. **📊 结果：** RATS在LIBERO-PRO和MolmoSpaces上分别比CaP-Agent0提升20.6和17.0个百分点，所学技能可在不微调底层模型的情况下迁移至RoboSuite（+8.9 pp）和真实世界任务（+8.8 pp）。

question1.question: What two components does RATS's 'Goldilocks' scoring function balance when selecting play-time tasks?
question1.option1: Object-skill novelty and competence frontier
question1.option2: Execution speed and policy accuracy
question1.option3: Random exploration and greedy exploitation

question2.option1: Verified → Experimental → Deprecated
question2.option2: Experimental → Verified → Deprecated
question2.option3: Deprecated → Experimental → Verified

question3.option1: Curious play alone provides larger gains than the full RATS execution system alone
question3.option2: Play and test-time execution are complementary, with their combination yielding the best results (44.3%)
question3.option3: Random play with full RATS execution outperforms curious play on average

question1.question: RATS的'Goldilocks'评分函数在选择play-time任务时平衡哪两个组成部分？
question1.option1: 对象-技能新颖度与能力前沿
question1.option2: 执行速度与策略准确性
question1.option3: 随机探索与贪心利用

question2.question: RATS中的技能遵循三阶段可靠性生命周期。新技能在积累证据后遵循的正确发展顺序是？
question2.option1: 已验证 → 实验性 → 已弃用
question2.option2: 实验性 → 已验证 → 已弃用
question2.option3: 已弃用 → 实验性 → 已验证

question3.question: 在LIBERO-PRO消融研究中，关于play策略与测试时执行系统之间关系的关键发现是？
question3.option1: 仅使用好奇play带来的提升大于仅使用完整RATS执行系统
question3.option2: play与测试时执行是互补的，二者结合可获得最佳结果（44.3%）
question3.option3: 随机play配合完整RATS执行在平均表现上优于好奇play

title: EnterpriseClawBench: Benchmarking Agents from Real Workplace Sessions
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper introduces EnterpriseClawBench, an enterprise agent benchmark constructed from real proprietary workplace sessions, situated in the domain of LLM agent evaluation for enterprise/workspace tasks.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on Claw-style benchmarks (WildClawBench, ClawBench, Claw-SWE-Bench) and enterprise benchmarks (Workspace-Bench, EnterpriseBench, TheAgentCompany), and its new idea is to derive reproducible benchmark tasks directly from naturally occurring internal enterprise sessions rather than human-authored or simulated scenarios.

3.  **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses three gaps: (1) tension between enterprise realism and scalable task construction, (2) the need for multidimensional evaluation beyond single model scores, and (3) the lack of task-class-level skill generalization testing.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** The paper proposes an automated construction pipeline (mechanical gates, fixture recovery, prompt rewriting, taxonomy assignment, hard rules, semantic rubrics), a multidimensional evaluation framework combining hard rules with text/visual LLM judges across 32 harness–model combinations, and a consumer–creator skill injection matrix for skill-transfer testing.

5.  **📊 Results:** On the 120-task Lite subset, the best configuration reaches only 0.663 (Codex/GPT-5.5); harness–model coupling significantly affects scores (e.g., Claude-family models drop under Hermes), cost–score shows diminishing returns, GPT-5.5 is the strongest generalist, and visual judges are much less reliable than text judges (MAE 0.303 vs 0.134).
content_zh:
1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 论文介绍了 EnterpriseClawBench，一个基于真实企业内部工作会话构建的企业级智能体基准测试，属于大语言模型智能体在企业工作空间任务中的评估领域。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于 Claw 系列基准（WildClawBench、ClawBench、Claw-SWE-Bench）及企业基准（Workspace-Bench、EnterpriseBench、TheAgentCompany）等研究，其新思路是直接从企业内部自然产生的会话中导出可复现的基准任务，而非使用人工编写或模拟的场景。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 论文旨在解决三个空白：(1) 企业真实感与任务可扩展构建之间的矛盾；(2) 需要超越单一模型分数的多维度评估；(3) 缺乏任务类别层面的技能泛化测试。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** 论文提出自动化构建流水线（机械门控、依赖文件恢复、提示改写、分类法分配、硬性规则、语义评分标准），结合硬性规则与文本/视觉大模型评判器的多维度评估框架（涵盖 32 种 harness–模型组合），以及用于技能迁移测试的消费者–创造者技能注入矩阵。

5.  **📊 结果：** 在 120 个任务的 Lite 子集上，最佳配置仅取得 0.663（Codex/GPT-5.5）；harness–模型耦合显著影响得分（如 Claude 系列模型在 Hermes 下表现下降），成本–得分呈边际递减，GPT-5.5 为最强通用模型，而视觉评判器的可靠性远低于文本评判器（MAE 分别为 0.303 和 0.134）。

question1.option1: Skill quality is the only determining factor; consumer ability is irrelevant to transfer success
question1.option2: The outcome depends on creator quality, consumer behavior, creator–consumer fit, and the baseline score of the consumer
question1.option3: Skill injection always improves performance regardless of which model is used as creator or consumer

question2.question: Which model is identified as the strongest generalist in EnterpriseClawBench, and which role classes are reported to be the hardest?
question2.option1: Sonnet 4.6 is the strongest, leading in marketing and finance/operations
question2.option2: GPT-5.5 is the strongest generalist leading across multiple role classes, while marketing and finance/operations remain harder
question2.option3: Opus 4.6 is the strongest overall, dominating code/JSON and presentation tasks

question3.option1: Visual judges are more accurate than text judges because they can directly inspect rendered output

question3.option3: Visual judges and text judges perform identically because both use the same underlying Sonnet 4.6 model

question1.option3: 无论使用哪个模型作为创建者或消费者,技能注入总能提升性能

title: KaLM-Reranker-V1: Fast but Not Late Interaction for Compressed Document Reranking
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on document reranking in information retrieval, specifically proposing an efficient reranking model for large-scale retrieval systems.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds upon existing encoder-based rerankers (e.g., BERT reranking), decoder-based generative rerankers (e.g., RankGPT, BGE, Qwen3-Reranker), and late-interaction models (e.g., ColBERT, ColBERTv2); its new idea is the "Fast But Not Late Interaction" (FBNL) paradigm that decouples passage encoding from query-side relevance modeling while preserving expressive fine-grained interaction through decoder cross-attention.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off in existing rerankers—encoder/decoder-based rerankers tightly couple query and passage computation requiring expensive online re-encoding, while late-interaction methods sacrifice fine-grained query-passage interaction for efficiency.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The paper uses an encoder-decoder architecture (based on T5Gemma2) where the encoder pre-encodes passages offline with Matryoshka Embedding Pooling (MEP) for compression, and the decoder processes system/user instructions and queries, computing relevance through merged self-attention and cross-attention over query context and compressed passage representations; trained via a three-stage pipeline (general reranking, task-specific adaptation, and knowledge distillation).

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** KaLM-Reranker-V1 (in Nano/0.27B, Small/1B, Large/4B sizes) achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on BEIR, MIRACL, and LMEB benchmarks with significantly lower online computation cost (e.g., 10× efficiency gain over gte-reranker-base, 2× over bge-reranker-v2-gemma); moderate MEP compression (r=2 to r=8) preserves performance with minimal degradation, while the 0.27B Nano model is competitive with 7-12B embedding models on LMEB.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 论文聚焦于信息检索中的文档重排序领域，提出了一种面向大规模检索系统的高效重排序模型。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于现有的基于编码器的重排序器（如 BERT 重排序）、基于解码器的生成式重排序器（如 RankGPT、BGE、Qwen3-Reranker）以及晚期交互模型（如 ColBERT、ColBERTv2）；其新思路是提出"快但非晚期交互"（FBNL）范式，通过解码器交叉注意力将段落编码与查询端相关性建模解耦，同时保留表达力强的细粒度交互。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了现有重排序器中效率与效果之间的权衡问题——基于编码器/解码器的重排序器将查询和段落计算紧密耦合，需要昂贵的在线重新编码，而晚期交互方法为效率牺牲了细粒度的查询-段落交互。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文采用编码器-解码器架构（基于 T5Gemma2），其中编码器离线对段落进行预编码并使用 Matryoshka 嵌入池化（MEP）进行压缩，解码器处理系统/用户指令和查询，通过合并的自注意力和跨注意力对查询上下文与压缩的段落表示进行相关性计算；通过三阶段训练流程（通用重排序学习、任务特定适应、知识蒸馏）进行训练。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** KaLM-Reranker-V1（Nano/0.27B、Small/1B、Large/4B 三种规模）在 BEIR、MIRACL 和 LMEB 基准上实现了最优或具有竞争力的性能，同时在线计算成本显著降低（例如比 gte-reranker-base 效率提升约 10 倍，比 bge-reranker-v2-gemma 提升约 2 倍）；适度的 MEP 压缩（r=2 至 r=8）几乎不损失性能，其中 0.27B 的 Nano 模型在 LMEB 上与 7-12B 的嵌入模型具有竞争力。

question1.question: What is the main innovation of the 'Fast but Not Late-Interaction' (FBNL) paradigm proposed in KaLM-Reranker-V1 compared to traditional late-interaction methods like ColBERT?
question1.option1: FBNL eliminates cross-attention entirely and relies solely on similarity operations for query-passage matching.
question1.option2: FBNL decouples passage encoding for offline pre-computation while preserving expressive relevance modeling through the decoder's cross-attention over query context and pre-encoded passage representations.
question1.option3: FBNL uses a single encoder to jointly process queries and passages, similar to BERT rerankers, but with reduced parameters.

question2.question: According to the paper's analysis of Matryoshka Embedding Pooling (MEP), which compression ratio range is recommended for practical deployment to balance efficiency and effectiveness?
question2.option1: r = 1 (no compression) is the only acceptable setting to preserve performance.
question2.option2: r = 16 to r = 32, as these provide maximum storage savings with negligible performance loss.
question2.option3: r = 2 to r = 8, as moderate compression preserves most reranking effectiveness while substantially improving efficiency.

question3.question: Which foundation model serves as the backbone for initializing the KaLM-Reranker-V1 series, and what is the activated parameter count of its largest variant?
question3.option1: T5Gemma2 backbone, with the Large variant having 4B activated parameters.
question3.option2: BERT backbone, with the Large variant having 4B activated parameters.
question3.option3: T5Gemma2 backbone, with the Large variant having 8B activated parameters.

question1.question: KaLM-Reranker-V1提出的'快但非晚交互'（FBNL）范式相较于ColBERT等传统晚交互方法，其核心创新是什么？
question1.option1: FBNL完全消除交叉注意力，仅依赖相似度运算进行查询-文档匹配。
question1.option2: FBNL将文档编码解耦以实现离线预计算，同时通过解码器对查询上下文和预编码文档表示的交叉注意力保留富有表现力的相关性建模。
question1.option3: FBNL使用单个编码器联合处理查询和文档，类似于BERT重排模型，但参数更少。

question2.question: 根据论文对Matryoshka嵌入池化（MEP）的分析，在实际部署中推荐使用哪个压缩率范围来平衡效率和效果？
question2.option1: r = 1（不压缩）是唯一可接受的设置，以保持性能。
question2.option2: r = 16 到 r = 32，因为这些设置可提供最大存储节省且性能损失可忽略不计。
question2.option3: r = 2 到 r = 8，因为适度压缩可在大幅提升效率的同时保留大部分重排效果。

question3.question: KaLM-Reranker-V1系列使用哪个基础模型作为初始化骨干网络，其最大变体的激活参数量是多少？
question3.option1: T5Gemma2骨干网络，Large变体具有40亿激活参数。
question3.option2: BERT骨干网络，Large变体具有40亿激活参数。
question3.option3: T5Gemma2骨干网络，Large变体具有80亿激活参数。

title: PlanBench-XL: Evaluating Long-Horizon Planning of LLM Tool-Use Agents in Large-Scale Tool Ecosystems
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper focuses on evaluating long-horizon planning capabilities of LLM tool-use agents in large-scale, retrieval-mediated tool ecosystems, with the benchmark instantiated in the retail domain.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on existing tool-use benchmarks (e.g., ToolBench, MCP-Bench, EscapeBench, ToolGym) that typically assume fixed visible toolsets, clean descriptions, or one-shot retrieval, and introduces PlanBench-XL, which uniquely combines tool retrieval, implicit sub-goal inference, bi-directional exploration (forward/backward anticipation), unreliable tool access, and scalable generation, along with a novel retrieval-time blocking mechanism simulating real-world tool failures.

3. **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the lack of benchmarks that evaluate LLM agents' ability to perform adaptive long-horizon planning under partial tool observability and unreliable tool conditions, specifically testing whether agents can iteratively retrieve tools, infer implicit sub-goals, and re-plan when tool-use paths fail.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The authors construct a benchmark of 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools using a scalable LLM-based generation pipeline (typed datatypes, executable tools, and backend databases), implement a retriever supporting three modes (input-conditioned, output-conditioned, and input-output-conditioned retrieval) for bi-directional exploration, and design a blocking module with three perturbation types (explicit failure, implicit failure, and semantic misleading) to simulate unreliable tool environments; they evaluate 10 frontier LLMs using metrics spanning task completion, exploration behavior, and execution quality, followed by trajectory-level error analysis.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** Results show that massive-tool planning remains highly challenging—even Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves only 77.06% accuracy in default settings while most models fall below 60%; GPT-5.4 collapses from 51.90% to 11.36% under the most severe blocking condition; exploration breadth (Mean EDT) strongly correlates with accuracy (r=0.902), but frequent searching alone is insufficient; implicit (silent) failures and longer recovery paths cause the largest performance drops; most failures stem from "irrecoverable drift" after partial progress rather than from lack of retrieval, and additional test-time compute yields only marginal gains, revealing that current agents lack robust adaptive re-planning capabilities.
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 论文聚焦于在大规模、检索中介的工具生态系统中评估LLM工具使用智能体的长视野规划能力，其基准测试在零售领域实例化。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 论文基于现有工具使用基准（如ToolBench、MCP-Bench、EscapeBench、ToolGym等，这些基准通常假设固定可见的工具集、清晰的工具描述或一次性检索），并提出了PlanBench-XL，独特地融合了工具检索、隐式子目标推理、双向探索（前向/后向预期）、不可靠工具访问及可扩展生成，并引入新颖的检索时阻塞机制来模拟真实世界的工具失败。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了现有基准未能评估LLM智能体在部分工具可观测性和不可靠工具条件下进行自适应长视野规划能力的问题，具体测试智能体能否迭代地检索工具、推断隐式子目标，并在工具使用路径失败时重新规划。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 作者构建了一个包含327个零售任务和1,665个工具的基准，使用可扩展的LLM生成管道（类型化数据类型、可执行工具和后端数据库），实现了支持三种模式（输入条件、输出条件和输入-输出条件检索）的检索器以支持双向探索，并设计了一个具有三种扰动类型（显式失败、隐式失败和语义误导）的阻塞模块来模拟不可靠的工具环境；使用涵盖任务完成、探索行为和执行质量的多个指标评估了10个前沿LLM，并进行了轨迹级错误分析。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** 结果表明大规模工具规划仍然极具挑战性——即使是Gemini-3.1-Pro在默认设置下也仅达到77.06%的准确率，大多数模型低于60%；GPT-5.4在最严重阻塞条件下从51.90%骤降至11.36%；探索广度（Mean EDT）与准确率高度相关（r=0.902），但仅频繁搜索并不充分；隐式（静默）失败和更长的恢复路径导致最大的性能下降；大多数失败源于部分进展后的"不可恢复漂移"而非检索不足，且额外的测试时计算仅带来边际收益，揭示了当前智能体缺乏稳健的自适应重新规划能力。

question3.question: 论文认为 PlanBench-XL 的阻塞设置不能被简化为简单的搜索问题。以下哪一项最能支持这一论点?
question3.option1: 用于评估的内部类型化状态图对智能体隐藏,智能体只能观察到自然语言形式的工具描述和部分输出

title: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper introduces NatureBench, a cross-discipline benchmark in AI for Science and agent evaluation, designed to test whether AI coding agents can surpass the published state-of-the-art (SOTA) on real scientific problems derived from Nature-family journals.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** It builds on prior paper-based reproduction benchmarks (e.g., PaperBench, CORE-Bench, ReplicationBench) and engineering-optimization benchmarks (e.g., MLE-bench, PostTrainBench, MLS-Bench), introducing the new idea of a discovery-oriented benchmark that uniquely combines paper-sourced tasks, genuine scientific domains, and SOTA-referenced evaluation.

3. **❓ Problem:** It addresses the lack of a credible benchmark that evaluates whether AI coding agents can move beyond reproduction to genuine method discovery on natural science problems, overcoming the environment-fragmentation problem that has limited prior agent-on-research benchmarks.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** The authors built NatureGym, an automated three-stage pipeline (Paper Filtering, Dataset Acquisition & Verification, Task Package Construction) that converts Nature-family papers into standardized containerized task packages with information firewalls, and evaluated 10 frontier agent configurations across 90 tasks spanning six scientific domains under a strict web-search-disabled protocol with SOTA-normalized relative gap scoring.

5. **📊 Results and Evaluation:** The strongest agent (Claude Opus 4.7) surpasses SOTA on only 17.8% of tasks and matches it on 47.8%, with successes driven primarily by methodological translation into supervised prediction (45.5%) rather than scientific invention, and failures dominated by wrong method choice (45.1%) and insufficient compute budget (24.4%).
content_zh:
1. **📘 主题与领域：** 该论文提出了NatureBench，一个跨学科的AI智能体评估基准，测试AI编程智能体能否在源自Nature系列期刊的真实科学问题上超越已发表的SOTA水平，跨越AI for Science与智能体评估领域。

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 该工作基于先前的论文复现基准（如PaperBench、CORE-Bench、ReplicationBench）和工程优化基准（如MLE-bench、PostTrainBench、MLS-Bench），提出了一种独特的发现导向基准，结合论文来源任务、真实科学领域与SOTA参考评估。

3. **❓ 问题：** 该论文解决了现有基准的不足：要么仅关注论文方法的复现，要么仅针对Kaggle等工程优化问题，缺少能够评估AI编程智能体是否能在自然科学问题上实现真正方法发现的可信基准。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 作者构建了NatureGym，一个三阶段自动化流水线（论文筛选、数据获取与验证、任务包构建），将Nature系列论文转化为带有信息防火墙的标准化容器化任务包，并在禁用网络搜索的严格协议下，使用SOTA归一化相对差距评分，评估了10个前沿智能体配置在90个跨6个科学领域任务上的表现。

5. **📊 结果与评估：** 最强的智能体（Claude Opus 4.7）仅在17.8%的任务上超越SOTA，在47.8%的任务上与之持平，成功主要通过将科学任务转化为有监督预测的方法学转换（占45.5%）而非真正的科学创新，失败主要由错误的方法选择（45.1%）和计算预算不足（24.4%）导致。

question1.question: According to the analysis of solution mechanisms, what is the primary way agents achieve Match-SOTA results on NatureBench?
question1.option1: Methodological translation, recasting scientific tasks as familiar supervised-prediction problems
question1.option2: Genuine scientific invention of novel domain-specific methods
question1.option3: Random trial and error across thousands of submissions

question2.question: How does the information firewall in NatureBench's task package design affect what the agent can access?
question2.option1: It removes the source method so the agent only sees dataset inputs, task brief, and held-out test set
question2.option2: It blocks all internet access but reveals the original paper's title and abstract
question2.option3: It provides the agent with the paper's algorithm but hides the dataset

question3.question: Based on the cross-domain difficulty gradient, which scientific domain was the most challenging for agents, showing the lowest consensus Match-SOTA rate?
question3.option1: Relational Reasoning
question3.option2: Cellular Omics
question3.option3: Biomedical Modeling

question1.question: 根据论文对解题机制的分析,智能体在NatureBench上达到Match-SOTA结果的主要方式是什么?
question1.option1: 方法迁移——将科学任务重新构建为熟悉的监督预测问题
question1.option2: 真正的科学创新——提出领域特异性的全新方法
question1.option3: 在数千次提交中随机试错

question2.question: NatureBench任务包设计中的信息防火墙是如何影响智能体可访问内容的?
question2.option1: 它移除了源方法,使智能体只能看到数据集输入、任务简报和保留测试集
question2.option2: 它阻止所有互联网访问,但透露原始论文的标题和摘要
question2.option3: 它向智能体提供论文的算法,但隐藏数据集

question3.question: 根据跨领域难度梯度分析,哪个科学领域对智能体最具挑战性,其共识Match-SOTA率最低?
question3.option1: 关系推理
question3.option2: 细胞组学
question3.option3: 生物医学建模

title: CLI-Universe: Towards Verifiable Task Synthesis Engine for Terminal Agents
content:
1. **📘 Topic and Domain:** The paper addresses the data synthesis engine for LLM-based terminal agents, situated at the intersection of AI agents, synthetic data generation, and CLI task automation.

2. **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** Building on prior terminal-agent work (e.g., Terminal-Bench, SWE-agent) and synthetic data pipelines (taxonomy-based and environment-harvesting approaches like SkillSynth and TerminalTraj), the paper proposes an "inside-out" synthesis engine that grounds tasks through structured capability specifications and evidence-guided deep research rather than retrofitting from surface artifacts.

3. **❓ Problem:** It solves the scarcity of high-quality, executable training data for terminal agents, where existing pipelines scale task volume but produce ambiguous instructions, shallow execution paths, and brittle tests that yield weak learning signals.

4. **🛠️ Methods:** A three-stage pipeline is used: (1) task blueprint construction via multi-dimensional capability taxonomy and evidence-guided deep research, (2) environment realization into Dockerized containers with materialized assets, and (3) multi-stage executable verification including rubric-gated test construction, hint-conditional filtering, and fail-to-pass checking.

5. **📊 Results:** Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B on only 6,000 CLI-Universe trajectories achieves 33.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, setting a new SOTA among ≤32B open-source models and surpassing several models an order of magnitude larger, with strong generalization to BFCL v4 and VitaBench.

2. **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 基于既有终端代理研究(如Terminal-Bench、SWE-agent)及合成数据流水线(基于分类法和环境采集的方法如SkillSynth、TerminalTraj),论文提出"由内而外"的合成引擎,通过结构化能力规范和证据引导的深度研究来锚定任务,避免从表面材料进行改造。

3. **❓ 问题：** 论文解决了终端代理缺乏高质量、可执行训练数据的问题,现有流水线虽扩展了任务数量,但生成的指令模糊、执行路径浅、测试脆弱,导致学习信号微弱。

4. **🛠️ 方法：** 论文采用三阶段流水线:(1)通过多维能力分类法和证据引导的深度研究构建任务蓝图;(2)将蓝图实现为包含具象化资产的Docker化环境;(3)多阶段可执行验证,包括基于评分标准的测试构建、提示条件过滤以及"失败-通过"校验。

5. **📊 结果：** 仅用6,000条CLI-Universe轨迹对Qwen3-32B进行微调,即在Terminal-Bench 2.0上取得33.4%,在≤32B开源模型中创下新SOTA,并超越多个大一个数量级的模型,同时在BFCL v4和VitaBench上表现出良好的泛化能力。

title: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
content:
1.  **📘 Topic and Domain:** This paper belongs to the intersection of mobile operating systems and AI agents, proposing an open-source OS-level agent harness (AOHP) built on AOSP for personalized, efficient, and secure agent-mediated interaction on Android devices.

2.  **💡 Previous Research and New Ideas:** The paper builds on prior GUI-agent systems (e.g., AutoDroid, AppAgent, UI-TARS, OS-Copilot), Android automation frameworks (e.g., DroidBot, ScreenAI), and information-flow control systems (e.g., FIDES, TaintDroid); its new idea is to redesign the OS itself—treating agents as first-class OS actors—rather than only improving agent policies on top of a fixed, app-centric substrate.

3.  **❓ Problem:** The paper addresses the architectural mismatch between conventional app-centric operating systems and agent-mediated workflows, which causes execution overhead, inefficiency, and security risks because existing OSes cannot efficiently support cross-app agent tasks or properly track sensitive data propagation.

4.  **🛠️ Methods:** The paper designs and implements AOHP on AOSP with three core mechanisms—personalized service composition (task-level synthesized entrances), efficient agent interfaces (parallel background interaction, structured UI, native sandbox runtime, unified file shortcut, event stream abstraction), and secure information flow (source sanitization, vault-based trusted execution, and taint tracking)—and evaluates it using the OpenClaw agent on 30 self-crafted mobile benchmark tasks.

5.  **📊 Results and Evaluation:** Evaluation shows that AOHP raises task completion rate from 54.44% to 75.56% (+21.12%), reduces tool calls by 44.64%, duration by 44.21%, token consumption by 51.55%, and LLM requests by 47.62%, while security case studies on an annotated payment app confirm successful enforcement of sensitive-data sanitization, mediation, vault usage, taint propagation, and fail-closed behavior.
content_zh:
1.  **📘 主题与领域：** 本文属于移动操作系统与AI智能体交叉领域，提出基于AOSP构建的开源操作系统级智能体框架AOHP，用于在Android设备上实现个性化、高效且安全的智能体中介交互。

2.  **💡 先前研究与新思路：** 本文基于现有GUI智能体系统（如AutoDroid、AppAgent、UI-TARS、OS-Copilot）、Android自动化框架（如DroidBot、ScreenAI）以及信息流控制系统（如FIDES、TaintDroid）；其新思路在于重新设计操作系统本身，将智能体视为一等公民，而非仅在固定的应用中心化平台之上改进智能体策略。

3.  **❓ 问题：** 本文解决了传统以应用为中心的操作系统与智能体中介工作流之间的架构不匹配问题，该不匹配导致执行开销大、效率低下以及安全风险，因为现有OS无法高效支持跨应用智能体任务，也无法正确追踪敏感数据的传播。

4.  **🛠️ 方法：** 本文在AOSP上设计并实现了AOHP，包含三大核心机制——个性化服务组合（任务级生成入口）、高效智能体接口（并行后台交互、结构化UI、本地沙箱运行时、统一文件快捷方式、事件流抽象）以及安全信息流（源净化、基于保险库的受信执行和污点追踪），并使用OpenClaw智能体在30个自构移动基准任务上进行评估。

5.  **📊 结果与评估：** 评估结果显示，AOHP将任务完成率从54.44%提升至75.56%（+21.12%），工具调用减少44.64%，时长缩短44.21%，token消耗降低51.55%，LLM请求减少47.62%；同时在带注释的支付应用上的安全案例研究证实敏感数据净化、中介、保险库使用、污点传播和故障关闭行为均得到成功执行。
